title: Composed supervisory control: State sequence with per-stage timeout -> Paused three-stage sequence with abort and per-stage timeout

inputs.name: A_Stop
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Stop and reset-to-idle command

outputs.name: B_Fault
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Abort or timeout lockout

outputs.name: B_State
outputs.description: Subsystem B: 0 idle, 1 stage1, 2 stage2, 3 stage3

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The runtime scan period is 100 ms.
Subsystem A: Sensor completion is expected within 500 ms of entering each stage.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The runtime scan period is 100 ms.
Subsystem B: Pausing resets rather than accumulates the stage timeout.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Start in idle shall enter stage 1 and energize only A_Actuator1.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Sensor1 shall transition stage 1 to stage 2; A_Sensor2 shall A_Complete stage 2 and return idle.
requirements.property: G((A_State=1 AND A_Sensor1)->X(A_State=2)) AND G((A_State=2 AND A_Sensor2)->X(A_State=0))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: Either stage remaining incomplete for 500 ms shall latch A_Fault and return idle with both actuators off.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Stop shall return idle and turn both actuators off without clearing A_Fault.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_ResetFault clears A_Fault only while A_Stop is TRUE and A_Start is FALSE.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Complete shall pulse only on the stage-2-to-idle completion transition.

While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Start in idle shall enter stage 1; each matching Done input advances exactly one stage, and B_Stage3Done returns idle with a one-scan B_Complete pulse.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Pause shall retain B_State while forcing every actuator FALSE; Done inputs while B_Paused shall not advance.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_Pause -> (!B_Actuator1 AND !B_Actuator2 AND !B_Actuator3 AND X(B_State)=B_State)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: The active stage shall time out after 500 ms of unpaused execution and latch B_Fault.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Abort shall immediately return idle, force safe outputs, and latch B_Fault.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_Abort -> (B_State=0 AND B_Fault AND !B_Actuator1 AND !B_Actuator2 AND !B_Actuator3)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset clears B_Fault only in idle while B_Start, B_Abort, and every Done input are FALSE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: At most one actuator may be TRUE, and B_Complete shall never coincide with an actuator.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (at_most_one(B_Actuator1,B_Actuator2,B_Actuator3))) AND G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_Complete -> (!B_Actuator1 AND !B_Actuator2 AND !B_Actuator3)))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_Actuator1 shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_Actuator1 AND NOT B_Actuator2 AND NOT B_Actuator3 AND NOT B_Paused AND NOT B_Complete AND NOT B_Fault AND B_State=0)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_Actuator1 AND NOT B_Actuator2 AND NOT B_Actuator3 AND NOT B_Paused AND NOT B_Complete AND NOT B_Fault AND B_State=0))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
